DEF-01.name: Leaked API keys
DEF-01.description: Exposed secrets or API keys visible in client or repository code.

DEF-02.name: Unprotected admin routes
DEF-02.description: Administrative routes accessible without server-side authentication.

DEF-03.name: Database injection
DEF-03.description: Direct string interpolation in database queries allowing SQL or Cypher injection.

DEF-04.name: Crashes on unexpected input
DEF-04.description: Unhandled exceptions or missing error boundaries causing process crashes.

DEF-05.name: Infinite loops
DEF-05.description: Synchronous infinite loops or unconstrained hook re-render cascades.

DEF-06.name: Dead buttons on the main flow
DEF-06.description: Non-functional buttons or empty click handlers on critical conversion paths.

DEF-07.name: No loading state, double submission
DEF-07.description: Form submit buttons missing disabled states during active submission.

DEF-08.name: No limits on what people can type
DEF-08.description: Unbounded user inputs without maxLength or schema validation.

DEF-09.name: Search and sort are wrong
DEF-09.description: Non-debounced search inputs or naive string sorting on numeric data.

DEF-10.name: Slow pages and heavy images
DEF-10.description: Unoptimized images exceeding 2MB degrading web performance.

DEF-11.name: Over-complex files
DEF-11.description: Files exceeding 500 lines of code hindering maintainability.

DEF-12.name: Debug code and no documentation
DEF-12.description: Active console logging, debug statements, or missing README documentation.

DEF-13.name: Outdated methods
DEF-13.description: Usage of deprecated browser APIs or obsolete runtime methods.
